notes.title: The Horny Update is now Live!
notes.content:
[h2]I am happy to announce that the Horny Update is now live! [/h2]

The update features multiple new characters, 40 new side quests to unlock in the new "Extra Errands" menu (Unlocked after the first time beating the game) , and a bunch of new secrets to find. Along with that there has also been a lot of quality of life changes and bug fixes! Have fun exploring the wacky world of House Sitter, and remember to get all of those "Extra Errands" done too!

[h3]Also be sure to grab the game while its 40% off during the Summer Sale! [/h3]

notes.title: Announcement : The Horny Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Announcement : The Horny Update [/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37781577/0bde648a02795520b472a9afa58219fff8fdb160.png[/img]


[h3]The Horny Update will be the first major post-launch content update to House Sitter![/h3]

[h3]New Features to be Added-[/h3]
[list]
[*] The French Horn character will receive more of a purpose in the game besides just being there. Most item characters will be able to be inserted into the instrument. 

[*] The player will now be able to complete the Extra Errands List, filled with over 40 different events that you can find and accomplish in the game. This list even saves its progress between different playthroughs! This means not only will the player be able to track how much they have achieved during the game, they will also know how much content there is left to find! 

[*] New Item Characters that are essentially alternate versions of existing ones will be added to give the player new fun alternative events to accomplish. 

[*] A new Dimension to go to will be added, giving the character Moona Lisa more to do in the game.

[*] A new Furniture Character will join in on the fun, you can have some fun tipping off Ernie the Urn and help find him a new body...?

[*] The T.V character will receive a rework, giving him new sinister motives, and an alternative play-style he will encourage you to try.

[*] A new Speed Running mode enabled in the main menu may be added, giving the player an in-game timer, telling them their final time when the Credits roll. 

[*] A couple new Secrets that would be stupid to tell you about, because they are Secrets. 

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37781577/7adc27160c55c64769d00ecefbbf60f15048c637.png[/img]

[h3]Major Bugs/Issues To be Adressed-[/h3]

[list]
[*] Bug with characters getting glitched into the wall from the Washing Machine. 

[*] Bug with characters not coming out of Purgatory Dimension. 

[*] Issue where the Phone does not stop ringing if the player does not wish to answer it. (This makes speed-running annoying to do.)

[*] Bug with characters not coming out of Purgatory Dimension. 

[*] A particular Painting in the Art Gallery seems to be confusing players due to the character(s) depicted in it not actually appearing in the game, so an alternative will replace it.

[*] Issue where It doesn't make much sense that the Egg character would break when dropped from like 2 inches. 

[*] Issue where some events are repeatable such as the Bleach in the toilet. 

[*] Bug where players can glitch out of the world will be fixed... (Classic)

[*] Some other small bugs and issues that don't really effect gameplay that much. 
[/list]

[h3]

The Horny Update is expected to roll out around July 1st. 

Also be sure to grab the game during the summer sale! [b][i]The game will be 40% off starting June 26th! [/i][/b]

[/h3]
